page.notes: The "»" marks in the left margin are printed quotation marks beside each line of Eudoxus' speech; they are rendered as notes here. The word "noctuȝ" is printed as "noctuꝫ" with a ligature; read as "noctuq;" in the printed "noctuq;" form, with the printed sign. The catchword "crume-" is at the foot right; a hyphen is printed. The running head reads "IN ABDITAS RER. NATVR." with the page number 292 at the left. Spacing and ligatures (s, ꝫ) are approximate; the printed long s has been normalised to s in the transcription where it appears as s. Some words in the scan are faint and marked here as read with best effort.
